github-actions.rationale: Workflow actions should resolve to immutable reviewed content.

oci.rationale: Container bases used for reproducible/security-sensitive builds should have immutable image identity.

pypi.note: Pinned requirements files are also treated as reproducibility evidence; ranged pyproject dependencies may coexist with a resolved deployment manifest.

evidence_rule: A policy finding is review evidence, not proof of exploitability. Vulnerability state remains sourced from Dependabot/dependency review/other scanners.
